svg.title: The Vanilla Shop Vanilla & Rose soap box, flat 190.3 x 221.5 mm, 3 mm bleed

g.text: Rejuvenate your skin and spirit with The
Vanilla Shop vanilla and rose bathing
bar. It hydrates and protects your skin
with the natural antioxidant benefits of
vanilla and helps reduce fine lines,
while its warm aroma soothes the
senses and lifts your mood, leaving your
skin soft, radiant and youthful. Care for
Vanilla planifolia bean extract, Vanilla planifolia bean powder, rose extract, sodium palmate, sodium palm
Important: for external use only. Discontinue use if irritation occurs.
Net wt. 100 g · TFM 63% when packed
Made with vanilla grown on our own farms.
No 48, Sir Marcus Fernando Mawatha, Colombo 07
තවත් වැඩිදියුණු කරන්න. එහි ඇති උණුසුම්
The Vanilla Shop குளியல் பார் வயதான
බාහිර භාවිතය සඳහා පමණයි. අසාත්මිකතාවයක් ඇති වුවහොත් භාවිතය නවත්වන්න.
வெளிப்புறப் பயன்பாட்டிற்கு மட்டும். ஒவ்வாமை ஏற்பட்டால் பயன்படுத்துவதை நிறுத்தவும்.
